note: BH-8049: pr (default) | always | off. pr: a build attempt on a branch that already has a PR (SQUASH_OK=0, a dispatcher-supplied TARGET_BRANCH, or RB_PR_OPEN set) defers its backup pushes after execute and after each fix round, starts no checkpoint watcher, and pushes once at the end of the attempt (pr-push, or the EXIT trap for an attempt that ends early). It protects PR CI minutes: each push to a PR branch starts its CI and cancels the run before it. A first build with no PR keeps its backup pushes. always: defer every backup push. off: push after every commit-producing stage, as before. Any other value is read as pr.
